description: Answers 'what should I do today?' One digest across your courses: overdue work, work due soon, assignments with no due date, and the latest announcement subjects, each with the course name and due date. Submission status comes from the assignment list and the calendar adds quizzes and other activities. Input: course_ids, an optional array of course IDs to limit the digest; days_ahead, how many days ahead to look, default 14; overdue_days, how many days back to look for overdue work, default 14. Ask: 'What should I do today?'

items.description: Moodle course ID. Use get_my_courses to find it.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to look. Default 14.

overdue_days.description: How many days back to include overdue work. Default 14.
